title: Supplier data monitoring
description: Read-only view of source health, collection results, raw-record processing, and mapping backlog. It never switches sources or changes official data.

scorePolling.title: Automatic live-score scheduling
scorePolling.description: Read-only visibility into live-score polling. An expired lease indicates a previous task may have exited unexpectedly and can be reclaimed by a later scheduler run.

apiQuality.title: Supplier API call quality
apiQuality.description: Counts real collection and manual probe requests. Only source, operation, resource, status, error code, and duration are stored; URLs, secrets, headers, and response bodies are excluded.

takeovers.title: Actual source takeovers
takeovers.description: Only persisted takeover lifecycle records are counted. Activations in the selected window use activated_at; currently active includes active and reconciling. Proposals never count as activations.

latency.title: Supplier data delivery latency
latency.description: Only score and event snapshots with an explicit provider timestamp are included. The metric is local received time minus provider updated time; it is not per-event occurrence latency or pure network time.

postMatchRevisions.title: Post-match publication revisions
postMatchRevisions.description: For finished matches in the quality window, only matches with an official finished publication snapshot are eligible. Every later revision after the first finished snapshot counts as one post-match publication revision.
postMatchRevisions.limitations: This shows whether official snapshots continued to change; it does not judge correctness, and matches without a finished publication snapshot are excluded from the denominator.

conflictQuality.title: Primary-shadow supplier conflict rate
conflictQuality.description: Only field comparisons actually executed between the Sportmonks primary source and Goalserve shadow source in the current runtime window are included. Conflict rate is conflicting fields divided by comparable fields. {count} fields lacked sufficient data or dictionary mappings and are excluded from the denominator.

quality.title: Official match data presence
quality.description: Checks whether each official data group exists for {count} finished matches in the selected window. Presence does not prove semantic completeness.
quality.varNote: VAR evidence is the share of matches containing a VAR event. Until VAR applicability is configured per competition, absence must not be classified as missing data.
